primary_sources.contract: Chiesa-Manohar-Spooner Theorem 8.6: BCS for an IOP with RBR error epsilon gives O(t^2 epsilon + t^3/2^lambda); t includes adversary queries plus O(IOPqueries log proofLength). Concrete constants remain to extract. Definitions8.3/8.4 specify state, nonrepair by prover moves, and bounded escape at verifier moves. Proposition8.11 and Lemma8.13 connect acceptance and database escape.
Generic multiround Fiat-Shamir reduction has O(q^(2n)) loss; cannot assume q^2 without stronger protocol structure.
WHIR constrained RS IOPP; need exact theorem and parameter correspondence for pinned schedule, batching, OOD and terminal polynomial.
FRI RBR methodology; its classical ROM Q*epsilon formula is not the QROM bound.
SHA384 algorithm standard, not proof that concrete SHA384 is an ideal QROM oracle.

interface: Define the interactive protocol and all ordered prover/oracle/verifier moves, including bus auxiliaries and two PCS forks.
Define doomed(x, transcript) independently of future prover choices. False statement starts doomed. Every prover extension preserves doomed. A full doomed transcript rejects.
At every verifier move, bound probability of escaping doomed under the specified fresh uniform challenges, conditional on the entire prefix.
Relate extracted committed codewords to the same source table/auxiliary polynomial throughout AIR, shift and PCS stages.

Prove the new framed transcript/Merkle construction refines the BCS compiler, including query forks, rejection sampling, variable-length oracle inputs, statement adaptation and verifier-query overhead.
critical_gaps: A total interactive union bound alone does not prove RBR.
WHIR IOPP proximity guarantee must compose with constraint/shift reduction and batching; arbitrary encodings have no unique honest polynomial without a decoding-state argument.
Concrete constants in the QROM compiler and actual WHIR finite-field/correlated-agreement terms remain unresolved.
If adaptive public statements are required, the fixed-statement theorem must be strengthened or bound instance choice into the proven game.

sampling.proposal: Consume fresh domain-separated u32 words; accept w<2p and output w mod p, with p=2013265921. Each residue has exactly two preimages. Acceptance 2p/2^32 is slightly above15/16. Extend coefficientwise in a proved field basis.
requirements: Commit all relevant prover messages before draw; fresh counter/domain on each squeeze; never replay emitted seed material.
Bind field modulus, extension polynomial/basis, digest width, schedules, message lengths and protocol version.
Finite rejection cap rejects; never fallback to modulo. Honest abort probability and total oracle queries explicitly counted.
For at most2^32 coefficient draws and64 attempts each, a simple independent-ideal-word union bound for honest abort is below2^-224; this is not automatically a QROM simulation bound.
Power-of-two index domains use exact bits; preserve with-replacement semantics in query analysis.

field_proof_obligations: Irreducibility at every tower step; a nonsquare must be chosen in the actual intermediate field, not assumed from the base field.
Field laws, cardinality p^k, base embedding injectivity, serialization bijection, canonical basis ordering, inversion and implementation refinement.

Change auxiliary coordinate commitments from4*auxColumns to k*auxColumns and derive all batching widths/degrees again.
Audit vectorization, alignment, copy routines, serde, equality/hash and fixed-size coefficient buffers.

fixture_ledger.bus_degree_formula: max over send/recv sides of sum_i 2^n_i*(2^multBits_i-1)*max(1,messageWidth_i), plus exact public message factor degrees. Requires actual nonzero discrepancy polynomial proof.
fixture_ledger.caveats: Last two counts use current degree4 coordinate widths; not the whole WHIR proximity ledger. No bound here covers all NEAR transactions. RBR may use maximum per move after a compositional state proof; these conservative sums are only algebraic inventory.

budget_workbook.template: epsilon_total <= C_alg*t^2*epsilon_RBR + C_hash*t^3/2^384 + extra compiler/sampling/recursion errors. Constants and applicable theorem must be justified; t includes verifier expansion queries.
budget_workbook.illustration_only: Ignoring constants and extra verifier queries, t=2^64 gives hash term2^-192. Reserving2^-131 for an algebra event withD<=2^21 requires |K|>=2^(128+131+21)=2^280 under q^2 loss. Degree10 passes this single arithmetic test but is not a protocol parameter recommendation.
budget_workbook.allocation: Maintain separate exact rational ledger entries for bus, AIR mixing/zerocheck, shift, PCS batching/proximity, QROM compiler/hash, sampler/encoding and any recursive layer. Eight entries each<=2^-131 sum<=2^-128; no independence assumption.

implementation_order: 1 Root: new SHA384 primitive/reference profile with domain-separated framing, full384bit spec binding,12word roots, exact sampler, cross-language vectors; explicitly retain experimental label.
2 Formal: generic RBR state interfaces and sequential composition. Instantiate AST/shift false-claim stages first using existing root-count lemmas, preserving shared statements.
3 Research: pin concrete CMS19 constants and WHIR RBR theorem; map every custom fold/OOD/query/terminal rule and both branches, including full disclosure n1.
4 Ledger: derive worst-case shape/multiplicity/degree bounds from accepted public profiles and reject shapes outside certified envelope. Keep actual fixture ledger separately.
5 Only after bound closure: select/certify extension polynomial and implement generic degree-k arithmetic, sampler and coordinate encoding; audit all fixed-size assumptions.
6 Derive query schedule from complete proven bound, no heuristic margin/grinding credit. Regenerate actual D1 proofs and full shared-codec byte measurements; optimize batching if too large.
7 Recursion later: explicit quantum extraction and resource composition for the same statement; wrapper cannot upgrade weak inner proof.
